preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 200000 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each number a_i written on the vertices must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: There must be exactly n-1 edges, and each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '\n'.join(f'{i} {count}' for i, count in results if count > 0)
postconditions.description: The output must contain pairs of integers i and count for each i from 1 to 200,000 where count is the number of pairs (x, y) such that g(x, y) = i.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= 200000 for i, count in results)
postconditions.description: All integers i in the output must be within the range from 1 to 200,000.

postconditions.expression: all(count >= 0 for i, count in results)
postconditions.description: The count of pairs for each integer i must be non-negative.
